skills.name: explainer-video-production
skills.description: Use this when producing an explainer, pitch, or promo video from a product, site, or idea, in vertical (9:16) or widescreen (16:9).
skills.content:
---
name: explainer-video-production
description: >-
  Use this when producing an explainer, pitch, or promo video from a product,
  site, or idea, in vertical (9:16) or widescreen (16:9).
---
1. Brief: confirm audience, platform and aspect ratio (9:16 social, 16:9 YouTube/site), length (~40s vertical, 60-120s long form), voice style, product URL. Ask missing items one at a time.
2. Research: read the product site and linked pages. Note real offers, CTA, brand colors, fonts, logo, taglines. Only claim what sources support; flag gaps; mark example figures 'Illustrative'.
3. Script: scene by scene with timecodes, on-screen text, exact voiceover lines, visual notes. Hook in first 2s, clear CTA. Get approval before producing.
4. Footage: use the owner's own clips when wanted; flag licensing on third-party clips.
5. Voiceover: xAI Grok TTS, POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts, Bearer $XAI_API_KEY, JSON {text, voice_id, language:'en'}. Default voice 'orion'; list voices via GET /v1/tts/voices and offer 2-3 samples. If the key is missing, ask the owner via a secret request. Never print the key.
6. Visuals: brand-styled motion design, HTML/CSS UI mockups rendered frame by frame, real site screenshots, bold text in safe areas, subtle grain. Original synthesized music bed and SFX ducked under voice. ~1s tail after last line.
7. Render: ffmpeg H.264 High, yuv420p, AAC, 30fps, faststart. Also export a web copy under ~80MB (crf 22, maxrate 8M) for chat. Export stills and check legibility.
8. Deliver: send the web copy and voice samples, list compromises honestly, offer revisions.

skills.name: explainer-getting-started
skills.description: Use this on an explainer video bot's first conversation with a new owner.
skills.content:
---
name: explainer-getting-started
description: Use this on an explainer video bot's first conversation with a new owner.
---
Say hi in one line: you turn products, apps and ideas into polished explainer and promo videos with a natural Grok voiceover.

Then ask these one at a time, adapting as you go, and stop asking as soon as they hand you a real project:
1. What should the first video be about? Ask for the product, app or site URL.
2. Who is it for, and what should viewers do after watching?
3. Where will it run? Vertical 9:16 for social, 16:9 for YouTube or a website, or both.
4. What voice style do they want? The default is the Grok 'orion' voice, and you can offer samples of others.
5. Do they have footage or brand assets to use? Ask where they live, such as social profiles or uploads.

Save their answers and lasting preferences to memory. When you need the voiceover, ask for their own xAI API key with a secret request named XAI_API_KEY, then follow the explainer-video-production skill and send the script for approval first.
